g.title:
2. Huawei Cloud Platform (Digital Platform & Workflows) [Cloud Workload Tier] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Hosts containerized digital banking microservices on Cloud Container Engine (CCE), Temporal distributed saga workflow orchestrations, Multi-AZ PostgreSQL & GaussDB, Redis cache, and DMS Kafka event streaming backbone.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Executes digital customer journeys with cloud-scale elastic agility. Handles digital identity, card controls, transfers, bills, and notifications without placing transactional read load on core banking systems.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Customer Channels via Cloud WAF (HTTPS 443), Telco Aggregators via SMPP (Port 2775), Head Office Admins via Forcepoint SWG (Port 443) • OUTBOUND: Core Middleware on-prem via 1 Gbps Direct Connect MPLS (mTLS Port 443), Databricks Lakehouse via Kafka (Port 9092), Prisma Cloud & QualysGuard APIs (Port 443) • FAILOVER: Multi-AZ active-standby database replication (AZ1/AZ2) with <30s automatic failover, auto-scaled read replicas, and CCE multi-zone Kubernetes node pools. • SECURITY: Dedicated hardware KMS Customer Master Keys, Istio mTLS zero-trust pod mesh, OWASP Top 10 WAF, and Prisma Cloud container runtime security. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: 2. HUAWEI CLOUD WORKLOAD — DIGITAL BANKING PLATFORM, WORKFLOWS & CLOUD DATA
Read path: Cloud Read Replica & Redis Cache
Integrates with Maxut SafeToken & NIMC API
Direct Connect to Core Middleware & Switch
Card blocking, PIN change, limits, virtual cards
Airtime, Disco power tokens, cable TV, betting
Transaction alert SMS, email statements, push

g.title:
Temporal Workflow Orchestration Platform [Section 2: Huawei Cloud Platform] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Durable distributed saga state machine coordinator running on Kubernetes with dedicated workers for statements, reconciliation, KYC refresh, and standing orders.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Coordinates multi-step distributed financial sagas (e.g. debit sender account in Finacle -> call external NIBSS NIP -> confirm credit or execute automated compensation rollback on timeout).
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Digital Microservices via gRPC (Port 7233) • OUTBOUND: Cloud RDS PostgreSQL Temporal DB via PostgreSQL Wire (Port 5432), Core Middleware via Direct Connect (mTLS Port 443) • FAILOVER: Clustered Temporal history and matching services across multi-AZ; resilient state persistence with zero lost steps. • SECURITY: Internal VPC private subnet isolation, mTLS gRPC communication, and encrypted workflow state payloads. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: Durable distributed saga state machine coordinator for complex banking flows:
• Interbank Transfer Saga: Debit Finacle -> Call NIBSS NIP -> Compensate on timeout
• Digital Onboarding Saga: NIMC NIN Verification -> BVN check -> Finacle CIF creation
• Loan Origination Workflow: Credit Bureau query -> Risk scoring -> Disbursement
• Backing Persistence: Multi-AZ PostgreSQL & Redis State

g.title:
Huawei DMS Kafka Event Streaming Backbone [Section 2: Huawei Cloud Platform] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Managed Apache Kafka message bus cluster deployed across 3 Availability Zones with dedicated partitions for financial event topics.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: The enterprise event backbone connecting microservices asynchronously, buffering transaction events (`tx-events`), and streaming real-time CDC updates into Databricks Delta Lake Bronze.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Payment, Account, and Card Microservices via Kafka Wire (Port 9092) • OUTBOUND: Databricks Delta Lake Bronze Ingestion (Port 9092), On-Prem Kafka via MirrorMaker 2 over Direct Connect (Port 9092) • FAILOVER: 3-broker multi-AZ cluster with replication factor 3; zero message loss with min.insync.replicas=2. • SECURITY: SASL_SSL SCRAM-SHA-512 authentication, TLS 1.3 in-transit encryption, and topic-level ACLs. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: Huawei Distributed Message Service (DMS Kafka Event Mesh)
Enterprise Event Backbone for Cloud Microservices & Data Streaming:
• Core Topics: tx-events, customer-audit, notification-queue, cdc-streams
• Multi-AZ Cluster with 3 Brokers + MirrorMaker cross-region replication
• Feeds Real-Time Ingestion into Databricks Delta Lake Bronze Layer

g.title: Platform Observability & Service Mesh
g.text: • Istio Service Mesh: Mutual TLS (mTLS) zero-trust pod-to-pod encryption
• Application Performance Monitoring (APM): Distributed tracing & latency tracking
• Cloud Eye & Log Tank Service (LTS): Centralized syslog ingestion with 1-year retention

g.title: Cloud Hybrid Gateway
g.text: Cloud Hybrid Gateway (Direct Connect & IPsec Terminator)
• Dedicated Direct Connect 1 Gbps MPLS terminating to Primary DC on-prem
• Failover: Automated BGP failover to IPsec VPN tunnel over public internet
• mTLS Core API Client communicating with on-prem Core Middleware

g.title:
Huawei Cloud RDS PostgreSQL & GaussDB (Multi-AZ) [Section 2: Huawei Cloud Platform] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Enterprise managed relational database deployed in Active-Standby configuration across Availability Zone 1 (AZ1 Master) and Availability Zone 2 (AZ2 Standby).
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Stores digital customer profiles, onboarding draft applications, session metadata, notification queues, and workflow state for the digital banking platform.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: CCE Microservices via PostgreSQL Wire (Port 5432) • OUTBOUND: AZ2 Hot Standby via Synchronous Block Replication, Auto-Scaled Read Replicas via Streaming Replication, Databricks Delta Lake Bronze via Kafka CDC (Port 9092) • FAILOVER: Synchronous block-level replication with automated heartbeat failover in < 30 seconds (RPO = 0). • SECURITY: Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) with KMS CMK, SSL/TLS 1.3 enforced connections, and continuous audit logging to CyberSOC Africa. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: Huawei Cloud RDS for PostgreSQL & GaussDB
Primary transactional database for digital customer profiles & session state:
• CDC Source: Logical Replication Stream to Kafka & Databricks

g.title:
Cloud Read-Only Replicas (AZ1 & AZ2) [Section 2: Huawei Cloud Platform] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Horizontally scalable read-only database replicas deployed in AZ1 and AZ2 behind an internal database load balancer.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Offloads 85%+ of read-intensive customer operations (balance inquiries, mini-statements, transaction search) to prevent CPU and lock contention on the primary transactional master.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Account & Statement Microservices via PostgreSQL Wire (Port 5432) • OUTBOUND: Synchronized from Primary Master via Asynchronous Streaming Replication (lag < 100ms) • FAILOVER: Auto-scaling read replica pool; unhealthy replicas automatically detached by internal load balancer. • SECURITY: Read-only database role credentials, strict network security group isolation, and KMS encryption at rest. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: Horizontally scalable read query offload for mobile/web inquiries:
• Offloads 85%+ of read traffic: Account balance, statement generation, transaction history
• Asynchronous streaming replication from Primary Master (lag < 100ms)
• Auto-scaled behind internal database load balancer

g.title:
DCS Redis Enterprise (Multi-AZ Master-Replica) [Section 2: Huawei Cloud Platform] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: High-performance in-memory caching cluster deployed in Multi-AZ Master-Replica mode with automated Sentinel failover.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Delivers sub-millisecond retrieval of active customer login JWTs, OTP challenge states, API consumer rate limiting counters, and branch master lists.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: API Gateway & Microservices via RESP protocol (Port 6379) • OUTBOUND: In-Memory replication to AZ2 Standby Replica • FAILOVER: Automated Sentinel failover to AZ2 replica in < 5 seconds; dual persistence with Append-Only File (AOF) and hourly RDB snapshots. • SECURITY: Redis AUTH password authentication, TLS encrypted transport, and private subnet placement. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)
g.text: In-Memory caching & high-speed session token management:
• Master in AZ1 with synchronous in-memory replication to Replica in AZ2
• Sub-millisecond latency for OTP verification, login tokens & API rate limiting
• Dual persistence: Append-Only File (AOF) + RDB snapshot every hour

g.title:
Cloud Backup and Recovery (CBR) & OBS WORM Archive [Section 2: Huawei Cloud Platform] ================================================================================ 1. WHAT IT DOES: Comprehensive cloud data protection suite managing automated database snapshots, cross-region replication, and long-term cold storage.
2. ROLE IN WHOLE ARCHITECTURE: Guarantees point-in-time recovery (PITR) for all cloud databases, protects against cloud regional disasters, and complies with CBN financial record retention directives.
3. HOW IT CONNECTS TO OTHERS: • INBOUND: Cloud RDS PostgreSQL & GaussDB via Continuous Log Shipping (every 15 min) • OUTBOUND: Secondary Huawei Cloud Region via Cross-Region Snapshot Sync, Cloud OBS Archive Tier via WORM Object Lock (7-Year Retention) • FAILOVER: Multi-region snapshot availability; one-click point-in-time database restoration. • SECURITY: KMS Customer Master Key encryption, immutable WORM (Write Once, Read Many) bucket policies, and NDPA 2023 compliance. (Click box on diagram for interactive detail view)

g.text: Transaction log backups captured every 15 minutes; 35-day restore window
Daily database snapshots replicated to secondary cloud region (Protection against regional outage)
Monthly cold exports in KMS-encrypted OBS with Object Lock (7-year CBN retention)
• Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) at rest with dedicated KMS Customer Master Key
• SSL/TLS 1.3 enforced for all microservice connections with strict certificate pinning
• Automated vulnerability scanning via QualysGuard & Prisma Cloud CSPM
• Database audit logs streamed continuously to CyberSOC Africa SIEM
